subject: Request: PT extract for SOC 2 mapping + remediation owners and ETAs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: report@trustguard.io, laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Request: PT extract for SOC 2 mapping + remediation owners and ETAs

Hi team,

Following up on the recent pen test engagement with TrustGuard: we need a redacted extract of the findings that maps each finding to the relevant SOC 2 control family (CC6.x / CC7.x or equivalent) and a short list of the evidence artifacts you collected (log snippets, request IDs, screenshots). We cannot share the full unredacted report externally with Acme, but Acme has asked for a finding-level summary and evidence handback for their compliance review.

Can TrustGuard provide:
- A CSV (or spreadsheet) with one row per finding: finding id, severity, short description, suggested control mapping, evidence filenames (if any), and whether the finding is reproducible.
- Any per-finding artifacts that can be shared (redacted) via a secure file share.
- Confirmation of any findings that were judged as "design" vs "implementation".

Internal owners: Laura / Ben / Grace — once TrustGuard hands this over, please triage and commit owners/ETAs for remediation. I want a first-pass remediation owner assignment by EOD 2027-03-20.

Attachments: scope-statement.pdf (original PT scope provided by Acme)

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: TrustGuard Pentest <report@trustguard.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 13:04:12 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: PT extract for SOC 2 mapping + remediation owners and ETAs

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the note. We can provide a redacted extract and a per-finding evidence bundle. Per our engagement terms we can't re-distribute the full report without Acme's sign-off, but the CSV extract and redacted artifacts are allowed.

Deliverables we will seed to you by 2027-03-22:
- trustguard-extract.csv (columns: finding_id, severity, short_desc, cwe, suggested_control_mapping, reproducible_flag, artifact_names)
- A secure ZIP with redacted screenshots/log-snippets for findings we classified as High/Med (separate archive for Low)

Quick notes on a few items we flagged during triage:
- TG-003 (AuthZ misconfig) — medium; reproduces on staging; evidence includes auth-logs and request-id 0b3a2c
- TG-007 (CI service account key exposure) — high; artifact: ci-key-snapshot.txt (will be redacted)
- TG-012 (Network ACL overly permissive) — low; recommended NACL tighten to deny 0.0.0.0/0 for management range

We'll upload the bundles to the secure share and ping you when ready.

Regards,
Asha Malik
Senior Consultant, TrustGuard Pentest
report@trustguard.io
Attachment: trustguard-extract.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: PT extract for SOC 2 mapping + remediation owners and ETAs

Thanks Asha / TrustGuard — and thanks Jonas for surfacing. Per the extract we received, I did a quick triage and assigned owners/ETA for initial remediation tasks. See owner list below (first-pass):

- TG-003 (AuthZ misconfig - medium) — Owner: Ben Carter 
  - Work: tighten role mappings for internal admin role, add explicit deny for cross-account assume where not required, add test to CI.
  - ETA: 2027-03-29
  - Evidence to collect: IAM policy diffs, test run output, auth request logs (request-id 0b3a2c)

- TG-007 (CI service-account key exposure - high) — Owner: Grace O'Connor
  - Work: rotate the compromised key, remove key from CI images, enable ephemeral SA tokens, add guardrails in pipeline.
  - ETA: 2027-03-26 (keys rotated + pipeline PR opened)
  - Evidence: rotation event ids, new workflow run ids, keystore rotation entry

- TG-012 (Network ACL permissive - low) — Owner: Mateo Alvarez
  - Work: update NACL to remove 0.0.0.0/0 on management subnet; add reviewer check.
  - ETA: 2027-04-01
  - Evidence: VPC NACL diff, deployment audit log

Action items for product/security: please create JIRA tickets (link to SUP-4321 where we will track) and drop artifacts into the shared Drive folder so we can return the evidence bundle to Acme and mark findings closed in the tracker.

Laura Bennett
Security Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 07:48:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: PT extract for SOC 2 mapping + remediation owners and ETAs

Laura — noted. Quick update from my side:

- I have a branch that scopes the admin role and a PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1984) targeting 2027-03-27 for merge to staging.
- We'll also add a CI test to prevent regressions (integration test run scheduled).
- One caveat: legacy analytics job J-legacy-az still requires broader permissions for data access; I'm proposing a compensating control (restrict run window + IP allowlist + monitoring alert) while engineering schedules a refactor. Can we get a temporary SLA exception for that job?

I'll attach PR + sample policy diff to the JIRA ticket SUP-4321.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Engineer, Platform
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: report@trustguard.io, acme-sec@acme.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: PT extract for SOC 2 mapping + remediation owners and ETAs

Thanks everyone — short summary and next steps: 

- TrustGuard will upload the redacted extract + artifact bundles by EOD 2027-03-22.
- Internal owners (Laura's list) to create JIRA tickets under SUP-4321 and populate the shared Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/PT/Acme-Extract-2027
- Evidence handoff target to Acme: 2027-03-25 (we will confirm once artifacts are in Drive).
- Ben: proceed with PR/CI changes; note the legacy job exception request — Laura, please advise on temporary SLA exception process.
- Grace: confirm key rotation completed and paste rotation event IDs in the Drive folder.

Attachments: acme-action-items.xlsx (high-level handoff checklist)

If anyone expects a delay to their ETA, reply with the updated ETA and reason. I will compile a snapshot for Acme and for SOC 2 auditors once items are closed.

Jonas Weber
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
